items.text: Trade: the Arizona Cardinals have agreed to trade WR Marvin Harrison Jr. and 2027 7th-round pick to the Houston Texans in exchange for a 2027 2nd-round pick and 2027 6th-round pick, per @rapsheet and me.
items.implication: Major roster move; fantasy value reset for MHJ and ARI WRs.

items.text: FINAL UPDATE: Ashton Jeanty will play. Terry McLaurin will play. Projections updated.
items.opportunity: carries for Jeanty; targets for McLaurin

items.implication: Start Jeanty as lead RB; sit elevated backups.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is active today vs. the Saints. Vikings WRs Jordan Addison and Odell Beckham Jr. are inactive today.
items.why: Jefferson cleared for homecoming; Addison out.
items.implication: Jefferson full WR1; Addison sit/zero; possible volume boost to Jefferson or others.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja’Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, both listed as questionable for today, both will play against the Dolphins.
items.implication: Start both confidently; CIN passing attack upgraded.

items.text: So many coaching staffs have refused to go workhorse on Jaylen Warren. Including this one, who was making him split with Rico Dowdle pre-injury. Insane stuff. Passes every test... advanced stats, eye test. Austin Ekeler-esque.
items.why: Dowdle out; Warren elite profile ignored previously.
items.implication: Strong start/upgrade for Warren as lead back.

items.text: George Kittle officially active. (Earlier: illness but expected to play vs Seahawks.)
items.implication: Start Kittle as TE1; no backup TE boost.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active but not expected to play meaningful snaps.
items.why: Foot injury; dressed but limited role.
items.implication: Avoid starting; beneficiaries in LAC WR room get snaps/targets.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery has been downgraded to out with a groin injury.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup RBs elevated; HOU RB committee shift.

items.text: Actives today include: Keenan Allen, Jaylen Wright, Terry McLaurin, Ashton Jeanty. Inactives: Caleb Williams, Jordan Addison.
items.implication: Start Jeanty/McLaurin; bench Caleb (backup QB opportunity).

items.text: #Bears QB Caleb Williams is officially inactive but does have a chance to play next week.
items.implication: Backup QB start; Bears pass game downgraded this week.

items.text: Summary: NOT EXPECTED: Ladd McConkey, Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Marvin Harrison, Darius Slayton, Josh Palmer. GTD: Jefferson/Addison, Jeanty, McLaurin, DJ Moore. EXPECTED: Flowers, Carnell Tate, Rhamondre, Kamara, Keenan Allen. Later updates flipped several.
items.implication: Baseline for later flips; Dowdle out elevates Warren; MHJ out elevates Wilson.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers, who is listed as questionable for Sunday night due to a foot injury, is expected to play vs. the Falcons.
items.implication: Start Flowers; Lamar out context but WR1 role.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.implication: Priority waiver add for GB RB depth/handcuff upside.

items.text: The cruelest thing to happen to anyone that drafted Marvin Harrison Jr this year is him not being active to face the Lions secondary.
items.implication: Frustrating for owners; Wilson/others benefit short-term.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr has 5 catches in 4 games. He wasn't a real factor in any Michael Wilson stuff.
items.why: Production data; MHJ non-factor elevates Wilson.
items.implication: Wilson preferred in ARI even pre-trade; MHJ trade cements.
